description: This Go source file defines commands and functions for generating documentation for a GitHub MCP server project, including updating README and remote server docs with toolset and tool information.

methods.name: generateAllDocs
methods.description: Generates documentation for README.md and remote-server.md by calling respective functions.

methods.name: generateReadmeDocs
methods.description: Reads the README.md file, generates toolset and tool documentation sections, and updates the file content between specific markers.

methods.name: generateRemoteServerDocs
methods.description: Reads the remote server documentation file, generates automated toolset documentation, and replaces content between markers.

methods.name: generateToolsetsDoc
methods.description: Creates a markdown table listing all toolsets with descriptions.

methods.name: generateToolsDoc
methods.description: Creates detailed markdown sections for each toolset with their tools and parameters.

methods.name: formatToolsetName
methods.description: Formats internal toolset names into human-readable titles.

methods.name: generateToolDoc
methods.description: Generates markdown documentation for a specific tool, including parameters and scopes.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a slice contains a specific string.

methods.name: indentMultilineDescription
methods.description: Indents multiline descriptions for markdown formatting.

methods.name: replaceSection
methods.description: Replaces a section in content between start and end markers with new content.

methods.name: generateRemoteToolsetsDoc
methods.description: Creates a markdown table with detailed info about each remote toolset, including URLs and install links.
